findings: Exact diff is confined to nine existing scenario test files. Every before/after source hash and all22 case names match the review input; there are no production, helper, policy,508-bank or browser-source changes.

Nine diagnosed existing casts explicitly select useAlternativeCost=true and AlternativeCostType.FLASHBACK; Iroh Divination executes the existing offered flashback action after checking its selection. This replaces the previous normal alternative-zone cast request rather than assuming flashback from its origin zone.

Every changed case asserts the real stack SpellOnStackComponent reports paid FLASHBACK and the existing untapped basic-land setup pays the exact expected land count. The original land setups, targets, additional-cost identities and effect/exile assertions remain unchanged.

Laughing Mad preserves the exact Forest additional discard and adds immediate graveyard proof. Daydream and Moment of Glory preserve their exact permanent targets. The control hand casts and negative Iroh permissions remain unchanged.
required_next: Execute and audit actual receiving cases and full integration on the exact published successor. Source review is not a runtime pass.
